title: Earth Guardian Oracle: A 45-Card Deck and Guidebook By Kyle Gray

From the publisher

Retune yourself with the living, breathing being that is nature with this powerful 45-card oracle from best-selling author, card deck creator, and spiritual teacher Kyle Gray. The Earth has always been our first teacher, our first temple, and our first guardian. Her ancient wisdom lives in every river, stone, and star, whispered through the guardians who walk between worlds – protectors of both Earth and spirit. The Earth Guardian Oracle is a living bridge to that sacred wisdom. Within these cards, the voices of the seasons and the Moon, the wild messengers of the animal kingdom, and the old ones of Celtic mythology rise to guide you and offer healing and protection. You’ll meet powerful archetypes such as Earth Mother, the Green Man, and the Lady of the Lake, alongside animal guardians of our wild spaces – Bear, Whale, and Hawk – while sacred gateways invite you to take your place within the turning Wheel of the Year. As you journey with this oracle, you’re called inward – into the heart of the Earth herself – to remember that you’re not separate from nature but woven into her eternal dance. Each card acts as a compass of light, offering grounded, direct guidance to help you rediscover your innate purpose, restore balance, and deepen your connection to the world around you.

title: Stardust Wanderer Tarot By Jen Sankey
body_html:
78 Gold Gilt-Edged Cards, Space Pirate & Mythic Tarot Adventure, Rider-Waite-Smith Based Deck, Zodiac-Enhanced Readings, 136-Page Illustrated Guidebook

Stardust Wanderer Tarot invites you on a cosmic voyage through a richly imagined universe of Space Pirates, gods, and goddesses. Follow Mena—the adventurous Fool of the deck—on an epic journey of self-discovery and transformation. While inspired by the Rider-Waite-Smith® system, this 78-card tarot deck offers its own unique pirate-themed Minor Arcana suits: Oars, Chalices, Coins and Swords. Each card features vibrant, jewel-toned artwork infused with a space opera aesthetic, mythology, and a touch of steampunk flare. Powerful deities and Space Pirates teach Mena about emotional growth, power, conflict, and everyday life across the galaxy. The gold gilt-edged cards feature zodiac symbols, which provide an extra astrological layer for readings. The included 136-page illustrated guidebook expands each card with elemental, planetary, and zodiac associations, along with upright and reversed card meanings.

Key Features:

  • Cosmic Tarot Adventure: 78-card tarot deck based on Rider-Waite-Smith®; space pirate mythology and epic narrative
  • Gold Gilt-Edged Cards: Shimmering, eye-catching celestial finish; enhanced durability and collectible appeal
  • Premium Card Stock: High-quality card stock; smooth, easy shuffling; ideal for frequent readings
  • Zodiac-Enhanced Readings: Zodiac signs printed on each card; added astrological dimension; deeper symbolic interpretation
  • Illustrated Guidebook Included: 136 pages; card meanings with elemental, planetary, and zodiac associations; unique pirate-themed spreads


Stardust Wanderer Tarot offers an unforgettable blend of cosmic storytelling, mythic symbolism, and premium craftsmanship—perfect for readers who want a tarot deck that feels like an epic journey through fate, identity, and the stars.

title: Encore Tarot By Ciro Marchetti
body_html:
82 Tarot Cards, Rider-Waite-Smith Tradition, Retrospective Collection of Ciro Marchetti's Tarot Art, Expanded Minor Arcana

Encore Tarot is a stunning culmination of Ciro Marchetti’s illustrious career, bringing together his personal favorite cards from decades of deck creation. Initially conceived as a personal retrospective of Marchetti's celebrated career, this deck has evolved over the years into an entirely independent masterpiece. This luminous collection has been meticulously reimagined in a sketch-like digital style to create a deck with its own distinct personality and soul. Moving away from the hyper-vibrant, rich color palettes of his previous decks, the artist embraced neutral sepia overtones, providing the deck with visual unity and allowing readers more interpretive freedom. While rooted in the Rider-Waite-Smith tradition, this 82-card deck includes four additional Palace cards—special sanctuaries for each suit. The 68-page guidebook offers diverse perspectives to help you explore your own intuitive insights.

Key Features

  • Distinctive Stylistic Statement: Features Ciro Marchetti’s iconic designs completely reimagined in a sophisticated, retro pen-and-ink sketching style; breath-taking tonal depth unifies the deck visually
  • Expanded RWS System: Based on the familiar Rider-Waite-Smith system for ease of recognition, yet incorporates unique modifications, extra characters, and a brand-new "Palace" card for each of the four Minor Arcana suits (Palace of Coins, Cups, Swords and Wands)
  • Premium Production Quality: Deck printed on high-quality cardstock engineered for maximum durability, effortless shuffling, and a luxurious tactile feel that withstands frequent use
  • Expertly Written Guidebook: Includes a comprehensive companion guidebook featuring personal interpretations, insights, perspectives, and custom layout spreads—such as the Lamplighter Spread and the New Moon Manifesting Spread, contributed by esteemed tarot professionals 
  • Ideal for Tarot Beginners: Deck follows traditional tarot structure; clear, familiar iconography; additional symbols support intuitive readings

Whether you are an intuitive reader, a beginner, an avid tarot enthusiast, or a retailer looking for a high-demand product with exceptional shelf presence, the Encore Tarot offers a sophisticated divination experience that instantly commands attention.

title: Inner Tarot: A Modern Approach to Self-Compassion and Empowered Healing Using the Tarot by Kate Van Horn
body_html:
“On its surface, this is a book about tarot, but at its core, it's offering a radical and revolutionary path to true healing." ―Liz Moody, host of The Liz Moody Podcast and author of 100 Ways to Change Your Life

Are you longing to rewrite your personal narrative, connect to your purpose, and pursue it with confidence? Do you seek a grounded approach to connecting to your intuition, being seen, heard, and heart-led? "Anyone interested in falling in love with their mind, body, and spirit should look to the tarot," says intuitive healer and tarot reader Kate Van Horn. "Tarot has an uncanny knack for illuminating what already exists in our energies, bodies, and intuitions. When harnessed, it can serve as a helpful tool for profound self-acceptance and healing."

The Inner Tarot isn't just a book about how to read the cards. It's a guidebook for those ready to embark on a healing journey equipped with tools to help you foster your intuition, own your story, and harness your soul's purpose.

Just like a deck of tarot cards, the book is divided into two parts:

• In Part I, you’ll learn to explore the nuances of pulling cards to ground you in the practice and discover the tools to become a confident reader. Consider it a crash course in card reading. Kate will also share tips for creating rituals around your deck, understanding numerology, reading reversals, crafting tarot spreads, and more.

• In Part II, Kate guides you through individual card interpretations as well as thought-provoking, heart-opening exercises intended to facilitate healing and honor your resilience and personal story. You’ll refer to this again and again as you create your tarot practice and make deeper connections with each archetype.

Discover a deeper approach to self-inquiry, a new depth in your experience, pride in your personal story, and an empowered approach to their communication.

title: Tarot Book of the Dead: A Chthonic Journey of Death, Mediumship, and the Art of Guiding Souls by Jenna Matlin
body_html:
“A compassionate, courageous, and beautifully conceived guide to one of tarot’s most sacred purposes: helping us face death, grief, and the unseen world with greater wisdom and compassion.” ―Amy Zerner and Monte Farber, artists and authors of The Enchanted Tarot and The Karmic Balance Tarot

The Tarot Book of the Dead provides a rare, comprehensive guide to tarot mediumship, grief work, and psychopomp practice. Author Jenna Matlin offers not only practical techniques but a transformational experience that reclaims tarot’s deep historical and mythological relationship with death and shows tarot readers that mediumship is absolutely within their birthright.

Structured as a chthonic journey―a descent into the Underworld, a trial within the depths, an ascent with wisdom, and a return to the living world forever changed―this guide focuses on three main themes: the dying, the dead, and the grieving. Readers can use this book for their own personal work, while it also provides guidance for people in fields that touch on death, including death midwives and doulas, grief workers, hospice carers, and mediums.

The Tarot Book of the Dead is, at its heart, an initiatory process and a hands-on guide through which readers can deepen their tarot practice and their relationship with death.

body_html:
Tap into guidance from the animal spirit realm and connect to ancestral wisdom with this transformative 44-card deck and guidebook from Indigenous Medicine Woman and author of You Are the Medicine and The Sacred Medicine Oracle, Asha Frost.

Everything is interconnected. All of creation carries a spirit. Indigenous people have always had a sacred relationship with animals and treated them as honored elders. Animal beings in the spirit realm are part of our spiritual support team as allies and medicine keepers, ready to help, waiting to remind you of your humanity and deep connection to the natural world.

With 44 Elder Animals depicted in a richly detailed traditional Ojibway art style, each card carries its own unique medicine. This deck offers meaningful insights and messages to guide you on your path both from the universe and in the voice of an animal spirit guide from the lands of the Ojibway people—from Elder Artic Hare to Elder Wolf. Whether you're seeking clarity, healing, or a deeper connection to your ancestral lineage, these cards provide a bridge to the spirit world.

Use this deck your rituals and ceremonies, do readings with it for your clients and friends, and share it with your communities. As the medicine ripples out, hold Indigenous people in your heart and honor how their history continues to impact your current reality.

title: Cottage Magic Tarot: A 78-Card Deck and Guidebook by Ann Shen
body_html:
Weave your own fairy tale through sun-dappled cottages and moss-covered castles with this exquisite tarot deck, featuring a guidebook to help strengthen your spiritual practice and inner wisdom.

Cottage Magic Tarot offers a cute and cozy deck for anyone who finds inspiration in the enchanting world of cottagecore. Featuring beautifully illustrated cards with unique suits—teacups, biscuits, quills, and candles—this tarot deck brings the charm of pastoral simplicity to the spiritual world of tarot reading.

Ann Shen's magical artwork imagines The Lovers as a pair of swans, Strength as a woman gently taming a bear, and the Queen of Teacups as a mermaid. The accompanying booklet explains how to tarot cards in various ways along with interpretations of each card in the deck to inform your readings.

Perfect for both seasoned tarot enthusiasts and newcomers alike, Cottage Magic Tarot invites you to explore the magic and tranquility of cottage life, providing guidance and insight with every draw. Uncover and explore the cozy, the mystical, and the magical in your life with this one-of-a-kind tarot deck.

title: Afro Fantasy Walking Tree Oracle: Plant Allies, Ancestor Magic, and Healing through Ritual and Ceremony by Monticue Connally
body_html:
Inspired by Afrofuturism and African spiritual traditions, this beautifully illustrated oracle deck is an invitation to connect deeply with your ancestors, the land, and the 9 realms

Includes a 200-page guidebook

Nothing is devoid of spirit. The Old Ways are calling to us, asking us to return to the future sooner than later. Discover plant allies and how to use them for healing and connecting to the realms. Rebuild and restore your relationship with the natural world inside and outside yourself. Participate in ritual. Commune with nature. Build relationship with ancestral energies.

For BIPOC healers, diviners, and metaphysical enthusiasts, this beautifully illustrated 50-card deck connects you to the living world through meditative practices. This deck allows you to spiritually connect to yourself and the environment in a way that isn’t defined or shaped as a response to whiteness.

Each card has a title and an inspiring original illustration by Jonathon Stalls. Using the guide book, you can access different corresponding features: ritual and herbs; planetary and zodiac correspondence; and medicine of the 9 realms:

  • The object realm
  • The physical realm
  • The ethereal realm
  • The astral realm
  • The mental realm
  • The intuition realm
  • The ancestral realm
  • The coincidental realm
  • The mythic realm


The Afro Fantasy Walking Tree Oracle can also be used as a diagnostic tool to connect the reader to ritual and medicine in nature.

Lore, Wisdom and Light for Your Magickal Path Wherever there are humans, there are solitary witches—independent emissaries of magick who love others but adore the companionship of the free and the wild even more. If ever you have yearned for moon-kissed mysteries, kinship with wildflowers, and ecstatic connections with Nature and her cycles, you have felt a witch’s wisdom stirring within. You may dwell deep in a forest or in an apartment within the very heart of a city. Wherever you abide, the whispers of the elements, plants, creatures, and cosmos infuse your world with fascination and freedom. Your new journey begins… Set includes 45 cards and 180-page guidebook. title: Black Bird Oracle Deck: A 52-Card Deck and Guidebook By Deborah Harkness, Hester Aspland
body_html:
Diana Bishop’s family oracle deck from the beloved novel The Black Bird Oracle comes to life in this magical 52-card deck from the #1 New York Times bestselling author of A Discovery of Witches, Deborah Harkness.

The Black Bird Oracle Deck is a recreation of the seventeenth-century deck that plays a pivotal role in The Black Bird Oracle, the fifth novel in the beloved All Souls series. Handed down in the Proctor family for centuries before witch and Oxford scholar Diana Bishop discovered its secrets, The Black Bird Oracle Deck features 52 oracle cards and a guidebook that invites readers into this powerful world of magic and divination. Wholly original and beautifully illustrated, the deck includes cards in the following categories:

I. Elements
II. Birds
III. Covens
IV. Tools
V. Principles
VI. Alchemical Processes
VII. Moon Phases
VIII. Magics

Cards are printed on high-quality paper with rounded edges and textural graining, and they are contained within a deluxe, clamshell box with a ribbon pull. A perfect gift for fans of the All Souls series or tarot enthusiasts, The Black Bird Oracle Deck will help readers divine the twisting paths of life.

title: Omen Oracle: A 44-Card Deck & Guidebook by Cat Pierce
body_html:
From the creator of The Wandering Star Tarot, this vivid, hand-painted oracle deck calls the reader to look within to discover the wisdom of the Universe.

Welcome to the world of The Omen Oracle—may it illuminate the path before you and reveal the profound magic that lies within you. Look closely, listen softly, and the Universe will reveal itself to you.

The Omen Oracle invites you to the sacred places where the veil between the worlds gently thins, guiding you on a journey of self-exploration and cosmic connection. As you explore this deck, you’ll move through four distinct categories—each a portal to deeper connection with yourself and the Universe.

Messages offer gentle prompts to stay open and curious, attuned to the signs all around you. Animals help you embody instinctual wisdom, inviting you to channel the strengths and energies of your spirit guides. Plants ground you in the healing clarity of the natural world, reminding you of your place within it. And Visio Divina cards—named for the sacred practice of “divine seeing”—invite you to meet the gaze of the artwork, allowing yourself to be fully seen and held in unconditional love.

title: Familiar Magic Pocket Oracle: A 44-Card Deck and Guidebook by Madame Pamita
body_html:
Harness the power of the animal and plant kingdoms in this original mini oracle deck. Communicate with your familiar, gain insight into the future and your inner world, and enhance your magical practice.

Discover the plants and animals who want to be our friends and magical allies in the mystical realm of The Familiar Magic Pocket Oracle. Each card features an animal and plant with a special relationship, along with a message for you related to their energetic vibration.

Use these cards for insight into the past, the future, and yourself. You'll receive loving guidance for the twists and turns of life while developing your intuition and enhancing your magical practice. Unique among oracle cards, this deck enables you to work with the animals and plants in your life.

  • Discover the plants and animals that want to start a familiar relationship with you.
  • Tap into your psychic abilities and open up a two-way conversation with your familiars.
  • Learn about the history and magical energy of each plant and animal.
  • Receive not only oracle messages but also specific messages for the witch, the animal familiar, and the plant familiar with each card.
  • Turn affirmations into magical incantations for your day.

title: Shadow of Darkness Oracle By Sirian Shadow
body_html:
For someone who desires something different from the "light and love" aesthetic, The Shadow of Darkness Oracle is an easy-to-use deck inspired by heavy metal music and equipped with the tools shadow work creates for transformation.

This incredible deck is your guide to uncovering blind spots in your life and healing from them. Through the profound practice of shadow work, you'll bring subconscious patterns to the surface, breaking free from limiting beliefs and gaining deeper insights into your darker aspects and suppressed emotions.The artwork in this deck, inspired by the rebellious spirit of heavy metal music, captures the essence of transformation and empowerment. Each card is designed to challenge you and stimulate introspection, inviting you to explore areas of resistance that may be holding you back. Whether you're a seasoned practitioner or just beginning your shadow work journey, The Shadow of Darkness Oracle offers powerful prompts and guidance to help you dive deep into your inner world.

title: Seasons of the Witch: Samhain Oracle DELUXE EDITION: Harness the intuitive power of the year's most magical night By Lorriane Anderson and Juliet Diaz
body_html:
Harness the intuitive power of the year’s most magical night, Samhain, with this deluxe, fully-expanded 60-card oracle deck. Includes 5 Altar postcards and stand!

At last, you can access the energy of Samhain with the sought-after, limited deluxe edition of Seasons of the Witch: Samhain Oracle by bestselling authors Lorraine Anderson and Juliet Diaz. This beautifully crafted, fully revised 60 card edition features 16 additional cards not included in the original 44-card deck. Premium finishes include a black velvet box and 5 Altar postcards of spells with a stand to place the cards in.

Housed in exquisite, high-quality packaging, and featuring beautiful illustrations, this limited edition is both a collector’s treasure and a cherished companion for lifelong seekers. It will become a sacred tool on your altar, a guide into the unknown, and a beautifully haunting reminder that magic is always just a breath away.

Your Samhain oracle should befit this extraordinary evening full of wonder and possibility. Samhain is more than a magical night on the calendar: it’s a threshold, inviting you further beyond the veil to commune with what was, what is, and what shall be. For this one fortuitous night, Samhain marks the Celtic New Year, the end of summer and the harvest season, and the arrival of winter.

This stunning oracle is perfect for the witches’ sabbat, but can be used year-round, whenever you feel drawn to seek ancestral whispers, unravel old stories, or dare to conjure new ones. Seasons of the Witch: Samhain Oracle calls forth the mysteries of shadow, spirit, and the spaces between.

An expanded edition of this beloved oracle, 60 beautiful comprise this strikingly crafted deck. Explore the luminous dark evoked by this night, using your own intuition

title: Rising Rani Oracle: Step boldly into greatness By Khaani
body_html:
Each beautiful Rani illustration in this deck holds universal and inspirational messages for all women.

The exquisite illustrations of Ranis in this 36-card oracle deck embody female empowerment. The Rani represents a divine feminine force: a confident, strong-willed and remarkable woman who is beautiful both inside and out.

Each Rani card reveals feminine power in a contemporary South Asian context, accompanied by inspiring affirmations. The deck draws on influences from Arabic, Gujarati, Hindu and Punjabi cultures, integrated with modern digital mediums. Themes of nature and spirituality foster a sense of belonging and comfort for modern women.

With this oracle, you can fuel your mindset, create everlasting changes and step into your higher self.

title: Qajar Oracle:A Persian miniatures card deck By Nova Mundi
body_html:
Unveil the art of connection: discover personality and relationships through the lens of Persian miniatures in this 44-card deck.

In Qajar Oracle, each card is a captivating masterpiece, beautifully blending the elegance of Persian Qajar miniature paintings with profound insights into the complexities of human personality traits.
Explore the depths of your intuition and enhance your connections with those around you through this unique deck, where art meets self-discovery. With every draw, unlock new perspectives and guidance that will unlock new perspectives, enrich your self-discovery journey. and deepen your understanding of yourself and others.
Revel in the resplendent design as you practice the ancient art of cartomancy.

title: Rise of the Witch Oracle: Guidance from the Pendle Witches By Claire Stone
body_html:
Unleash your inner magic with this 44-card oracle deck explores the legacy of the Lancashire Pendle witches through divination rooted in the rich history of the trials.

This deck draws on the legacy of the Pendle witches to encourage you to fiercely step into your power, manifest a rich and fulfilling life, and unapologetically unleash your inner magick. Explore England's most infamous witch trials through Claire Stone's sage wisdom and transformative insights. The Pendle Witch Oracle offers positive affirmations and meaningful solutions, allowing you to gain a deeper understanding of the world around you. Discover 13 Witch cards and 31 Spell Weaver cards, each infused with divinatory meanings rooted in the rich history of the era. The deck honours those wrongly accused in the Pendle trial by reclaiming the witch and encourages users to embrace magick and nurture the connection between women.
Each card is a gateway to the past, offering not just insights into your present and future but also a deeper connection to the rich legacy of these fascinating figures. Unravel the stories, unlock hidden secrets, and embark on a journey of self-discovery while celebrating the courage and strength of those who lived through one of history's most intriguing tales. Are you ready to find out what the cards hold for you?

title: Oracle of the Undead: Guidance from the grave By Corpse of Kay
body_html:
The undead are reaching out with their torn and rotting hands to guide you in this oracle deck. Listen to what they have to say - we're dead serious!.

It's time to take your life advice from beyond the grave, and the undead have plenty to say. Life can throw unexpected turns at any point but these zombies have the lived experience - and the brains - to help you through it. When you channel a zombie as your guide you can survive anything - and there's a whole horde in this deck to call on. This 36-card oracle deck and booklet bring the collective wisdom of the zombie horde to bear on your problems. They've been there, done that; who better to sort out the problems of the living?

title: Magical Spirit Oracle: The brilliance of you By Alexis Rakun
body_html:
A divination tool to deepen your connection with your own magic and Spirit

There is a profound magic to be found in our messy lives.
Through the unfolding of your life, you learn to no longer underestimate your own magic, and embark on a sacred voyage of remembering who you really are.

It's okay to get lost and then find your way back home, over and over.
What if you could source your power from and deepen your connection with the Divine?

These oracle cards will take you on a fantastical storytelling adventure of witches, grandmother trees, ancient archetypes, and sparkling portals.
And each card shares practical wisdom, rituals, and manifestation practices to take with you into your own life, as well as an affirmation spell to cast upon yourself.

There is a synergy to be found when we combine the two worlds of spirituality and the psyche, merging the mystical with the realistic.

If we want to grow to the heavens, we must be deeply rooted in the Earth.
You can, by some strange alchemy, turn the most ordinary of ingredients of life into the most extraordinary life magic.

The cards are the tools and YOU are the magic.

title: I Am Queen Oracle By Outi Harma
body_html:
An oracle deck that, like a mirror, will show you the Queen you are.

This imaginative and playful deck is an invitation to honour and celebrate the queen who lives in all aspects of ourselves. From the queens of Intuition, New Hope, Trying To Keep It Together and Resilience to the queens of Discovery, Mischievous Play and Taking On the World - and everything in between - each holds insights for you to ponder.

You are a queen and an infinite source of inner wisdom. Use this deck to align with that wisdom. Let it guide you. Let your radiance shine for all the world to see!

title: Coven Oracle By Fiona Horne
body_html:
Fortify your coven with this 36-card oracle deck by bestselling author and renowned witch Fiona Horne.

Infused with witchcraft, the Coven Oracle offers you guidance, wisdom and clarity on your magickal journey. This opulent deck will assist you in pursuing a path of harmony and respect, strengthening the bonds within your coven and steering you towards a powerful and unified magickal practice. Discover how to harness your coven's collective power with these insights and ideas.

title: Cosmic Reading Cards: Activation Cards for the Soul by Nari Anastarsia
body_html:
The Cosmic Reading Cards activate your soul to the memory of its true creative potential with 36 visionary cards plus 96 page guide book containing daily healing messages for growth, clarity and direction.

Created as a vehicle for universal love, Cosmic Reading Cards are life-enhancing tools, which provide clarity, understanding and guidance to life’s most complex questions. The messages in this deck emphasise that spiritual solutions can be realised when lifting our own vibrational states.

These soul-activating cards are a correlation of experiences that reflect the lessons of my own personal journey; with the creation of this deck divinely brought about through synchronistic acts of manifestation. These activation cards are intended to help you realize that everything that happens in your life is intricately woven together to assist you to transcend limiting beliefs and ascend to expansive states of conscious awareness.

title: Steampunk Lenormand (Reading Deck) by Barbara Moore and Diana Cammarano
body_html:
A brilliant new reading deck featuring all the brass clockworks, outfits, and accoutrements that fans of this style have grown to love. Designed as a more detailed view of the traditional Lenormand themes and symbols, the Steampunk Lenormand ups the ante with romance and intrigue spinning around human happenstances and elations. These feelings and insights bursting forth from these cards evoke a sense that you're on a grand adventure, joining in the human struggle against ordinary challenges as you reach out to achieve your own version of happiness and success.

- 36-Card Deck

title: Mystical Realm Tarot by Lisa Porter
body_html:
A unique, hand drawn compilation of vibrant tarot cards to take you on a visual and historic exploration of the Fools Journey.

We are spiritual beings, interacting with the spiritual realm every day. The veil has been torn and Mystical Realm Tarot has been created to be intentionally straight forward in relaying archetypal and symbolic messages to captivate the enquirer, while also displaying a concise narrative.

The beautiful images are hand illustrated by Lisa Porter who has chosen to feature a variety of historical eras, which adds interesting layers of visual content, without misinterpreting the traditional tarot meaning.

title: Marseille Vintage Tarot by Anna Maria Morsucci
body_html: This antiqued reproduction of the historical Marseille Tarot is perfect for readers and collectors who appreciate a vintage aesthetic and the wisdom it provides. body_html:

The Egyptian Book of the Dead is an ancient collection of spells, prayers and incantations, designed to guide the departed through the perils of the underworld and ensure eternal life. This oracle deck is based on these spiritual beliefs, with 50 cards representing gods, goddesses, funerary elements and aspects of ancient Egyptian mythology. Explore the tombs of the pharaohs and the concepts of heaven and hell, as seen by the ancient Egyptians.

Created by bestselling spirituality author Marie Bruce, this new oracle deck and accompanying guide will show the reader will discover how to apply the ideas from Ancient Egypt to divination and guidance for their daily lives.

title: Young Oracle Tarot by Suki Ferguson
body_html:
With Young Oracle Tarot, tweens and teens can explore the rich, mystical history of tarot, discover the symbols and meanings of the cards, and feel empowered to use tarot for self-reflection, self-care, and problem-solving. This enchanting treasury of all things tarot for readers ages 11 and up gives a fascinating insight into the history, secrets, and practice of tarot.

Featuring a foil-detailed cover, a ribbon marker, and stunning illustrations, Young Oracle Tarot reveals for young oracles-in-training what tarot is, how to read the cards for themselves and for others, and how this ancient mystical practice can be used for self-reflection, self-care, problem-solving, and much more.

For hundreds of years, people have sought answers to life’s big questions in tarot cards. This book will help young truth-seekers use the cards to navigate their own trials and triumphs, from family life, friendships and relationships, to school, work and health.

Everything readers need to get started on their tarot journey is contained in Young Oracle Tarot, starting with the rich history behind the cards and flowing forward to how they can be used today when relating to ourselves and to others, with simple card explanations and guidance for completing different readings.

The book includes:
~ A timeline of tarot through the ages
~ Examples of how today’s young readers can make the most of tarot
~ Tips on how to conduct personal readings and reading for others
~ Explanations of all the cards in the Rider-Waite-Smith deck, as well as information on other decks
~ Guidance on how to practice 1-card daily readings, 3-card draw readings, and Celtic Cross readings
~ A glossary of mystical terms

This magical guide will initiate readers into a powerful global tradition and empower tweens and teens to trust their intuition, recognize their strengths and talents, and reflect on and process situations and problems that are important to them.

title: Earth Power Oracle: An Atlas for the Soul by Stacey Demarco (Author), Jimmy Manton
body_html:
Everyone has felt a place of incredible power - be it a natural sanctuary, a breathtaking landscape, an ancient temple, a colossal shrine, the haunting ruins of a lost civilisation or even simply a sacred space in the home or garden. Many of the places on this extraordinary planet hold an energy that goes far beyond their physical beauty to stir within us the most powerful feelings of awe and wonder.

At the very heart of this stirring is the remembrance of an ancient time when humankind was intricately connected and in tune with the power of the Earth, its deep and eternal cycles, its magnetism, its electricity, its very aliveness.

Earth Power Oracle reconnects us with that reality, transmitting the energy of forty-one of the most deeply moving sacred places on the globe, capturing the essence of each one so that we may experience its unique beauty and profound insights. Bon voyage!

title: Divinations Of The Ancients: Oracle Cards by Flavia Kate Peters (Author), Barbara Meiklejohn-Free (Author)
body_html: In ancient times, across countless cultures throughout history, there were gifted oracles who spoke directly with nature, interpreted signs and omens, and communed with the gods for messages with extraordinary clarity and foresight. Much of this ancient wisdom and many of their divinatory tools have been forgotten with the passing of time.  This unique deck brings them together again, offering the chance to reconnect with different fortune-telling tools and modalities as well as rediscovering the ancient significance of a multitude of omens and signs from the universe. By rebirthing these lost arts of divination we reawaken our soul's connection with the world of spirit, and gain access to the symbolic answers that guide us to our heart's true desire and higher purpose.

Based on the groundbreaking Santa Muerte Tarot, this oracle is a powerful tool for working with the mysticism associated with the Day of the Dead and La Santa Muerte. Featuring masterful artwork by Fabio Listrani, each card offers inspiring wisdom and helps answer every question you ask.

The companion booklets for most Lo Scarabeo decks are in five languages: English, Spanish, French, Italian, and German.

title: Rackham Tarot by Arthur Rackham
body_html:
Arthur Rackham (1867 – 1939) remains one of the most celebrated artists of the early twentieth century. His ethereal paintings and illustrations for books like Rip Van Winkle, Peter Pan, and The Fairytales of the Brothers Grimm bring viewers into the magical land of faery, evoking the sense that we are surrounded by enchanting creatures at all times of the day. This breathtaking tarot deck features the most stunning illustrations from Rackham's body of work, inviting you to make a whimsical journey into the realm of the wee folk where unexpected insights and inspiration await.

The companion booklets for most Lo Scarabeo decks are in five languages: English, Spanish, French, Italian, and German.

title: Good Fortune Tarot by Barbara Moore (Author), Jessica Roux (Author)
body_html:
When we are tossed about by fate and pulled along by destiny, fortune gives us a life ring. This deck, much like how its dark-haired Justice card tips the scales with her knee, tips fortune in your favor by adding clever touches of the Marseille tradition to Rider-Waite-Smith imagery.

Jessica Roux's decadent illustrations bring new light to familiar symbolism and bestselling author Barbara Moore teaches you how to squeeze every drop of fortune out of even the direst situations. Featuring a sassy foreword by a fictional character who inspires daring souls like you, Good Fortune Tarot illuminates the road ahead so fate can't catch you off guard.

Includes linen-finish cards and a full-color guidebook printed with soy-based ink on FSC (Forest Stewardship Council) paper.

The Emperor and Empress cards fit together to create a panorama.

title: Girl Power Tarot by Sara Marzullo
body_html:
Celebrate iconic women throughout history with 78 remarkable female figures ranging from scientists and entertainers to politicians and athletes.

This deck honors the women who helped shape the world as we know it today. Paola Vecchi's unique illustration style captures the feminine energy of each heroine, from Oprah Winfrey to Dorothy Dietrich. Using Sara Mazullo's companion book, you'll learn how to channel that energy into your own life. This deck is a true and empowering tribute to womanhood.

Women featured include:
• Valentina Tereshkova
• Rose Hudson-Wilkin
• Bessie Smith
• Miss Mara
• Jane Birkin
• The Supremes
• Jeanne La Mar

title: Haptic Tarot By Nick Jacobs
body_html:
79 Art-Inspired Tarot Cards, Renaissance-Influenced Imagery, Tactile Intuitive Readings, Hands-Focused Symbolism, 60-Page Guidebook

Inspired by the masterpieces of early Renaissance Flemish artist Jan van Eyck, The Haptic Tarot offers a sensorial approach to tarot where hands become the primary language of intuition and meaning. Drawing on the concept of “haptic”—our sense of touch—this deck invites readers into a tactile journey of self-discovery. With the help of AI technology, tarot expert and designer Nick Jacobs harmonizes Smith-Waite symbolism with van Eyck's Realist flair, resulting in elegant and atmospheric images reminiscent of 15th-century oil paintings. The 79-card deck includes a bonus card, The Reader, and a 60-page guidebook with empowering messages for deep reflection.

Key Features:

  • Hands-Focused Tarot Symbolism: 79-card tarot deck; hands as the central storytelling element; bonus card, The Reader
  • Renaissance-Inspired Aesthetic: Visual homage to Jan van Eyck; early tarot iconography; timeless art-historical influence; celebrates tradition while embracing contemporary creative tools
  • Innovative Creative Process: Artwork created through a thoughtfully guided generative AI process; human-led prompts and curation; expanded visual depth and imaginative expression
  • Tarot Spreads and Keywords: Guidebook provides three keywords for each card; three tarot spreads for deep reflection
  • Premium Quality: Packaged in sturdy two-piece box; luxurious card stock for a tactile experience; smooth shuffling The Haptic Tarot offers a one-of-a-kind fusion of classical art inspiration and modern creative technology, inviting readers to explore tarot through touch, intuition, and deeply personal symbolism.


About the Creator:

title: Echoes Of The Wild Souls: Spirit Animals Of The Slavic And North Lands Martyna Szczykutowicz
body_html: Step into the wisdom of Slavic and Nordic animals and uncover the hidden powers of your soul. These cards guide you on a journey of inner clarity, healing, and spiritual connection. Each of the 31 animals carries a message of memory, freedom, love, courage, and transformation. Inspired by shamanic traditions and the natural rhythm of life, the deck invites you to rediscover yourself and reconnect with the world around you. The hand-drawn illustrations by the artist Martyna Szczykutowicz are vibrant, detailed, and magical – touching both heart and intuition. For those who seek depth, meaning, and connection. Includes a 128‑page full‑color booklet and silver metallic‑edged cards in a premium box.

title: Eight Coins' Tattoo Tarot Eight Elian-James Showell
body_html:
This vividly illustrated deck follows the artistic development of tattoo artist and designer Eight Elian-James Showell. The 82-card deck includes all of their original tarot art plus four new cards painted specially for this edition. The cards feature art forms and iconic imagery from both tattoo and tarot traditions, all hand drawn and painted using the watercolor painting style of “spitshading.” 

The 188-page book presents full-color, enlarged illustrations for each Eight Coins’ card, along with their descriptions and unique tarot insights. 

Set includes:
• 82 cards
• 188-page full color book
• Eight Coins’ Tattoo Tarot Rose Spread

title: Tarot of Secrets Tess Whitehurst
body_html: There are secrets here. Deep secrets. Timeless secrets to connect you with a formidable current of universal wisdom and renovate your world. The secrets are within you, just as they are in the soil, the clouds, the oceans, and the stars. The Tarot of Secrets, from renowned author Tess Whitehurst, offers the formula to unlock and embody these mysteries through your own transcendent DNA. Artist Ana Novaes re-imagines Tarot for the 21st century, weaving together traditional esoteric symbolism and everyday experience to produce an evocative deck that will be loved by novices and collectors alike. Ask questions. Look for answers. Contemplate the images and let the words speak to you. Approach this deck with the earnest desire of the Magician, the patient focus of the High Priestess, and the limitless enthusiasm of the Fool. Internalize the knowledge of the alchemists that echoes through the halls of eternity. Transmute the tin of your everyday experience and the lead of life’s challenges into a fountain of spiritual gold. Includes 78 cards and 352-page full-color illustrated guidebook.

title: Unlocking the Secret Garden Oracle Angi Sullins
body_html: There is a secret garden inside you, fortified by stone walls old enough to remember the moon’s first name. In this magic garden, every plant, flower, insect and animal is a portal, a passageway to secret knowledge and illuminated wisdom. You already have the keys to open each portal. This deck and guidebook are intended to accompany your own intuition as you navigate your way through the garden. Question-keys and answer-locks, when fitted together, open ancient passageways and doorways of opportunity, where you will discover wisdom treasure. Visit the garden to unlock the secrets still tucked away in your own potential. Set includes 44 gold gilt-edged cards, 108-page lushly illustrated guidebook and organza drawstring pouch. Packaged in a foil accented, magnetic hinged box.

title: Gratitude Oracle By Angela Hartfield
body_html: Greet your world with grace, resolve, and assurance with this glorious deck from Angela Hartfield and Josephine Wall. The practice of gratitude lifts your head and heart into a soulful place of calm, peace, and wonder. This deck combines whimsy and wisdom to deepen your appreciation for the gifts of life to help you build resilience, embrace hope, and discover the joy available to you each day. Contemplate these beautiful images and messages to renew your relationship with yourself and the world. Choose a card for daily inspiration or guidance on a specific matter for yourself and others. Includes 55 cards and 132-page guidebook.

title: Divine Masculine Healing Oracle Christabel Jessica
body_html:
The ancient gods have returned, guiding us to rediscover lost parts of ourselves and safeguard the sanctity of life. Throughout history, masculinity has been severed from the sacred — but it’s now time to embrace the insights from diverse pantheons and break the cycle of disconnection. 

This oracle celebrates the resurgence of a healed and integrated masculine energy, unlocking his honor and integrity. Created for those seeking a reunion with forgotten facets of their divinity, these cards reveal profound teachings inspired by the mythologies of many cultures, past and present. 

Designed to complement the feminine archetypes, the Divine Masculine Healing Oracle offers transformative wisdom via messages from Shiva, Horus, Eros, and other deities from around the world. Embody the Divine Masculine within, and liberate the suppressed parts of your personal power, now and forever.

title: Ask the Canine Sages: Wisdom From Our Beloved Dogs Tess Whitehurst
body_html:
For centuries, humans and dogs have shared an extraordinary bond of companionship, play, and comfort. Now you can tap into this special connection with the Ask the Canine Sages oracle deck. Each of the 44 beautifully illustrated cards features a different dog spirit—from the empathetic Alaskan Malamute to the confident Shih Tzu—offering gentle reminders that you are treasured exactly as you are. 

These wise canine guides are ready to support you through life’s challenges with their boundless hearts and intuitive wisdom. Whether you’re seeking clarity on relationships, courage for new ventures, or a nudge to find joy in the present moment, the dog spirits will spring forward to meet you with practical guidance and pure love.

title: Taste Buddies Tarot: Pocket-Sized Deck in Adorable Tin, 78 Tarot Cards and 68-page Booklet by M. Scorch
body_html:
Fill your plate and raise your glass as you indulge your appetite for positivity! Let the clever Taste Buddies answer all your tarot questions with comfort food, celebratory snacks and heaping hot bowls of wisdom. This whimsical deck offers encouraging messages and fresh palatable perspectives. The deck was designed with charming Kawaii style artwork to bring a happy twist to tarot readings, with no 'bad' or scary cards. While Taste Buddies Tarot follows traditional tarot structure, the four Minor Arcana suits and a few Major cards have been cleverly renamed with delightful results. Includes 78 cards and 68-page booklet of card meanings and custom card spreads in an adorable tin.

Key Features:

 

  • Whimsical 78-Card Deck: Humorous Kawaii-style artwork; food-inspired friendly figures; no bad or scary cards; perfect for all ages; printed on high quality cardstock
  • Positivity and Fresh Perspectives: Adorable food imagery and descriptions designed to create positive associations and evoke joyful emotional experiences
  • Fun for Foodies: Cute culinary cards serve up comfort food, celebratory fare, special event offerings, desserts and sweets, and hearty fare (Kings), chosen to symbolically align with the card meanings
  • Lively 68-Page Booklet: Witty and engaging writing; insightful and delightful interpretations, positive messages and keywords for all 78 cards; custom meal-themed card spreads
  • Clever and Unique Card Interpretations: Minor Arcana suits represented as Sticks (Wands); Bowls (Cups); Straws (Swords); Plates (Pentacles); Chopsticks represent skills to be learned; Queens are depicted with nurturing foods

 

 

For anyone who appreciates a humorous approach to the art of tarot reading, allow Taste Buddies to be your companions on this joyful tarot adventure. This handy tarot in a tin is perfect for all ages and skill levels.

title: Pixiekins: A Daily Inspiration Deck by Paulina Cassidy
body_html:
In day-to-day living, a little bit of encouragement and a dash of merriment go a long way. From her vivid imagination, popular artist Paulina Cassidy has created the adorable Pixiekins deck. Each of the 72 delightful creatures delivers a message of inspiration and magical thinking. Draw a card or two each day and let your intuition guide you in applying the Pixiekins' charming wisdom for a new perspective.

Deck includes 72 colorful character cards and one information card.

title: Elemental North Tarot by C. A. Mallad
body_html: The unique Elemental North Tarot presents a fascinating blend of tarot symbolism, Norse runes, astrology, elements and numerology, as well as plant and animal imagery. Inspired by the deep hidden meanings of tarot, the beauty of North American nature, and the symbology of the cosmos, the deck is infused with ancient wisdom, made accessible to modern readers. The artwork, featuring rune staves on each card, was intricately created to work intuitively, much like sigils and talismans. Discover the many aspects of divination each card holds in an engaging and enriching tarot experience like no other. Includes 78 tarot cards and an in-depth 148-page guidebook with card meanings, correlations, spellwork and manifestations.

Meet forgotten witches from history and lore―from curse bringers to fate turners―and discover familiars, spirits, deities, magical items, and magical places. title: Tarot: The Open Labyrinth―40th Anniversary Edition: Understanding Your Journey Through the Cards By Rachel Pollack
body_html:
Tarot: The Open Labyrinth―40th Anniversary Edition: Understanding Your Journey Through the Cards By Rachel Pollack

Tarot: The Open Labyrinth―40th Anniversary Edition: Understanding Your Journey Through the Cards by Rachel Pollack is a tarot deck available at Namaste Bookshop near Union Square in Manhattan.

About the deck

“Rachel Pollack was one of Tarot’s greatest teachers, and this book shows why.” ―Mary K. Greer, author of Essence of Tarot A Tarot reading lies open before us; all its images are placed on the table. Yet at the same time, they form a labyrinth, not simply a puzzle to be decoded but also a complex pathway deep into ourselves. In Tarot: The Open Labyrinth , renowned expert Rachel Pollack presents interpretations and commentaries on a collection of readings in this foundational book on divination. The approach is both comprehensive and specific, going steadily deeper into the person’s concerns in a context of light and dark, the Magician and the High Priestess. Through a recognition of this context, the subject and the reader open up their lives. In her classic Seventy-Eight Degrees of Wisdom , Rachel Pollack described how we can form meditation patterns―Tarot mandalas―to help us go beyond the reading itself. In this book, she gives examples of these mandalas and describes how people involved use them and their experiences. A previously lost classic from Tarot master Rachel Pollack, Tarot: The Open Labyrinth is for readers who wish to take their reading to the next level.

title: Tarot Vitae: Rider-Waite-Smith Symbolism, 78 Cards and 136-Page Guidebook by Marco Proietto
body_html:
Tarot Vitae explores the iconic symbols, scenery and characters of the Rider-Waite-Smith® deck, enlivening the traditional imagery with rich new details and a modernized color palette. The sensuously drawn figures here are not mere archetypes, but represent the flesh and blood of real life (Vitae), reflecting the emotions and aspirations we all experience. Every card tells a part of our story and invites us to contemplate our dual nature ― earthly and transcendent, reminding us that behind every symbol there is a living presence; one that feels, perceives, and seeks meaning. Includes 78 cards and 136-page guidebook, packaged in a premium tuck box.

Key Features:

 

  • Elegant Artwork: Inspired by the Italian intaglio engraving technique; precise and detailed line drawings; sensuously drawn figures with expressive faces
  • Premium Materials: Deck printed on superior quality card stock for durability and ease of shuffling; packaged in premium tuck box
  • Insightful 136-Page Guidebook: Keywords for upright and reversed readings; exploration of the imagery, symbolism and meanings; astrological and planetary associations for the Major Arcana; Flow of Life tarot spread
  • Faithful to Classic Rider-Waite-Smith: Traditional tarot landscapes and scenes with bold, new details; expansive color palette enhances symbolism; vibrant and eye-catching for beginners and seasoned collectors
  • Modern Tarot Experience: Engaging deck invites us to better understand and tell our own living stories through the colorful cards; accessible for readers of all levels

 

Tarot Vitae invites tarot readers of all levels of proficiency to connect with these familiar yet fresh and emotionally accessible tarot cards to better understand our life experiences.

title: Zodiac Oracle: The Heavens Speak by Tess Whitehurst
body_html:
Deepen your understanding of celestial influences and enhance your astrological practice with 54 stunningly crafted oracle cards and a guidebook.

For millennia, humans have turned to the sky for guidance in navigating our inner and outer realms. Western astrology weaves threads of psychology, myth, and fable with the moving tapestry of the planets―a potent, luminous framework for infusing your life with delight and direction.

Whether you are a novice or an expert, The Zodiac Oracle offers a welcoming gateway to the sacred language of astrology. With every reading, Tess Whitehurst's refreshingly honest wisdom combines with Jessica von Braun's visionary artwork to offer warm, relatable guidance and an abundance of magic.

The universe is waiting.

title: Witches' Wisdom Oracle Cards by Barbara Meiklejohn-Free
body_html:
Re-engage with the knowledge of the Old Ways! Each stunning card evokes the magic that connects you with the elements, mystical realms, and spirit to bring about a powerful sense of positivity and change in your life. Venture down this magical avenue and draw upon ancient wisdom that is still alive today.

This Witches' Wisdom Oracle Cards kit includes 48 silver-gilded oracle cards encapsulating the wisdom of the Wise: healers, teachers, herbalists, and gifted oracles who are the custodians of the magical potency of the Craft. Also includes a guidebook with sample spreads, easy to remember and repeat invocations, information about the cards, and much more.

Kit includes a 48-card deck and a guidebook.

title: Wicked Moon Tarot by Giorgia Farano
body_html: A young witch sets off on an incredible journey across four realms, each the embodiment of a season. Throughout this magical adventure cadenced by the sabbats, the girl must face trials and problems, meeting quirky characters and fantastic creatures that will help her along the way. This one-of-a-kind tarot is the visual representation of the Wheel of the Year, a true narrative experience to delve into the mysticism of nature and its never-ending cycle.

title: White Light Oracle Pocket Edition: Luminosity Pocket Edition by Alana Fairchild
body_html:
Enter a radiant dimension where light becomes divine medicine with this pocket edition of the White Light Oracle.

Featuring 44 cards exquisitely illustrated by A. Andrew Gonzalez, this pocket edition of a bestselling oracle deck helps you attune to the higher consciousness within. As you align with this deck's beautiful energy, blessings spontaneously arise in your heart to benefit your life, inspire your purpose, and support you to shine bright in our world. Alana Fairchild's wisdom is easy to take everywhere you go with this conveniently sized deck.

title: Wanderer's Tarot by Pierluca Zizzi by Sonya Kulynyak
body_html:
Immerse Yourself in the Lyrical, Evocative, and Symbolic Nature of the Verdant Woods

World-renowned artist Stephanie Pui-Mun Law invites you to slow down, breathe deeply, and embrace the sacred within the everyday. Rather than imposing a rigid interpretation of symbolism, Verdance Tarot allows the landscape and its inhabitants to speak. What comes forth is a deck that feels alive and uniquely suited to those who find solace and inspiration from the divinity of Earth.

This Rider-Waite-Smith-based deck explores themes of growth, transformation, intuition, and the interconnectedness of all life. Stephanie's visionary art serves as a poignant reminder that the health of our planet reflects the state of our collective consciousness.

With the full-color guidebook, you will find insight, comfort, and a deeper connection to the natural world. As you become a steward of the environment, so too will the sacred plants and enchanted creatures protect and heal you.

title: Verdance Tarot by Stephanie Pui-Mun Law
body_html:
Immerse Yourself in the Lyrical, Evocative, and Symbolic Nature of the Verdant Woods

World-renowned artist Stephanie Pui-Mun Law invites you to slow down, breathe deeply, and embrace the sacred within the everyday. Rather than imposing a rigid interpretation of symbolism, Verdance Tarot allows the landscape and its inhabitants to speak. What comes forth is a deck that feels alive and uniquely suited to those who find solace and inspiration from the divinity of Earth.

This Rider-Waite-Smith-based deck explores themes of growth, transformation, intuition, and the interconnectedness of all life. Stephanie's visionary art serves as a poignant reminder that the health of our planet reflects the state of our collective consciousness.

With the full-color guidebook, you will find insight, comfort, and a deeper connection to the natural world. As you become a steward of the environment, so too will the sacred plants and enchanted creatures protect and heal you.

title: Valentina Tarot by Guido Crepax
body_html: This elegant and energetic deck features Valentina, Guido Crepax's famous book and comic strip character, journeying through the tarot cards. Featuring Crepax's sophisticated art and lively renditions of Rider-Waite-Smith imagery, Valentina Tarot invites you to join Valentina as she interacts with the major and minor arcana. These lovely illustrations portray dream-like storytelling and fascinating characters, all wrapped up in a deck that's as wise as it is entertaining.

title: Tarot Etteilla: Anima Antiqua by Lo Scarabeo
body_html:
Explore the celebrated and unconventional tarot of Etteilla―a pivotal figure of esotericism in 1789―in this new, limited edition Anima Antiqua deck.

Jean-Baptiste Alliette―also known as Etteilla―was an occultist, researcher, and important figure of history. This deck is the philological reproduction of a tarot deck he designed, which connects the Arcana to other divinatory practices. Printed on high quality card stock and packaged in a premium box with a lift-top lid, this limited-edition deck is a must-have for historians and tarot collectors.

title: Tarocchi Fini Montecchi: Anima Antiqua by Lo Scarabeo
body_html:
From Lo Scarabeo's Anima Antiqua (Ancient Soul) series comes a premium, limited-edition reproduction of a Marseille deck originally created in Northern Italy.

The history of the Tarot de Marseille starts in Southern France at the beginning of the 18th century, but its popularity immediately spread into Northern Italy, giving birth to several unique decks, including this one from the city of Parma. Reproduced on premium card stock in deluxe packaging, this limited-edition deck is a must-have for collectors.

title: Starman Tarot Deck (Starman Tarot, 2) by Davide De Angelis
body_html: In 1995, David Bowie and Davide De Angelis began collaborating on album art for Bowie's album Outside, a creative working relationship that endured for more than seven years. Inspired by their collaboration, Davide De Angelis produced a fascinating tarot deck, decades in the making, that expertly weaves together intricate sacred geometries, alchemy, magic, and the sacred teachings of the world's mystery traditions. This deck-only edition of the Starman Tarot Kit is a must-have for Bowie collectors, and it will help you energize any creative project of your own.

title: Secret Language of Your Soul: An Oracle for Mind, Body and Heart by Inna Segal
body_html: A rich reserve of healing wisdom lies within you. Your body is a true messenger for your soul, and now you can decipher its signals with this sublime, 45-card oracle. A treasury of divination, actualization, and loving support, The Secret Language of Your Soul offers healing practices and soul-nourishing messages that enrich the connection to your divine nature. With gorgeous art by Jane Marin and guidance by bestselling author Inna Segal, you can express your soul and claim your most elevated reality.

title: Sacred Mothers & Goddesses: 40 Oracle Cards & Guidebook Set by Claudia Olivos
body_html: Become aware of your sacred femininity and attune to higher and deeper vibrations of the Goddess through activities, dedications, altar creation, and card layouts. Originally painted in oils on canvas, Claudia Olivos's channeled images hold unique, powerful energy to connect you with a sisterhood of deities for practical, loving, and ageless knowledge. Turn to this oracle for daily guidance, support, and a potent reminder of your valuable role in this time and in all of eternity.

title: Journey of Love Oracle Cards by Alana Fairchild
body_html:
Featuring 70 illuminating paintings by visionary artist Rassouli, the cards in Journey of Love are bursting with vibrant hues and stunning mystical depictions of feminine and natural beauty that help you connect deeply with the love that is at the very heart of everything in existence. Accompanied by exquisite poetic verses by Richard Cohn and profound messages of guidance by Alana Fairchild, these cards are designed to assist you to find your authentic path through the opportunities for growth presented to you in all aspects of life, especially in your relationships, not only with others, but in your sacred relationship with yourself. Ask the oracle whatever it is you yearn to know, then be carried on a journey through the mists of time, where your answers await...

Features 70 cards and 164-page guidebook, packaged in a hard-cover box set.

title: Healing Energy Oracle by Mario Duguay
body_html: Align yourself with the light, love, and wisdom of the divine with 54 thought cards from author and artist Mario Duguay. The energy generated by this deck will open you to a greater path for transformation, freedom, and self-realization. Choose a card, open yourself to the illuminated imagery and messages, and allow the healing energy to awaken your inner truths, peace, and blessings. The remarkable artwork evokes the sacred essence of color and light, attuning the mind and soul to levels of consciousness that support deep spiritual healing.

title: Goddess Astrology Oracle Cards by Tarn Ellis
body_html:
Celebrate the divine feminine in the sun signs and planets with this 38-card oracle deck's fresh perspective on ancient astrological wisdom.

Beautifully portraying each of the zodiac signs and planets as goddesses, Tarn Ellis' inspiring deck helps you develop a unique connection to the night sky. These gorgeous cards and the accompanying guidebook reveal the goddesses' archetypal energies and how you can embody them. Providing clarity and inspiration, this deck shows you how to unlock the magic within and step into your power like the goddess you are.

title: Forest of Enchantment Tarot by Lunaea Weatherstone
body_html: Once you step into the enchanted wood, your life―and your spirit―will never be the same. The forest is alive with magic: wise ancient trees, glowing blossoms, crystal caves, and forbidding thickets of thorns. Here you will meet witches and wizards, faeries and elves, birds and beasts both earthly and otherworldly, ghosts and shape-shifters, dancing princesses and sad old knights. As you wend your way along the twisting woodland paths, finding adventure at every turn, the old tales come to life. In the Forest of Enchantment, you may seek your fortune, quest for success, and live happily ever after.

title: Forest of Enchantment Oracle (Forest of Enchantment Tarot, 2) by Lunaea Weatherstone
body_html:
Inspiration Abounds in the Forest of Enchantment

What does the forest mean to the human psyche? What does enchantment mean to the human heart? Find out as you venture into the magical wood.

Designed to be used independently or with the Forest of Enchantment Tarot, this gorgeous deck and its color guidebook encourage you to travel deeper into the forest, expand upon the tales of its inhabitants, and find wisdom in their messages. You will not only find each card's divinatory meanings but also discover life-changing lessons meant to transform your own story.

Featuring thirty-six oracle cards and four Boon cards that enhance the others, this deck will enchant you with every reading.

Includes 40 cards and 120-page color guidebook

title: Casanova Oracle by Umberto Brunelleschi
body_html:
Casanova Oracle by Umberto Brunelleschi

Casanova Oracle by Umberto Brunelleschi is an oracle deck available at Namaste Bookshop near Union Square in Manhattan.

About the deck

More than a historical figure, Giacomo Casanova is a multi-faceted archetype whose name has become synonymous with love, lust, and libertinism. This erotic oracle is inspired by the life and text of the Venetian legend, capturing his romantic adventures and sexual exploits. With this deck, your divination skills and zest for life will both be burning with intense passion.

Highlights

  • Creator: Umberto Brunelleschi.
  • Local favorite: part of the tarot and oracle selection at Namaste Bookshop on 14th Street.

Specifications

  • Type: oracle deck
